scope: Rows in the operating systems table of Wikipedia List of metro systems. Source inclusion criteria apply; this is a discoverable directory, not verified complete world track or timetable data.
coordinateNote: Coordinates are primary coordinates of the linked city/area article from the Wikipedia API, with linked Wikidata P625 coordinates as fallback, used only as map search centers. Each row retains coordinateSource. They are not station coordinates or system bounds. Region is a broad browsing group; transcontinental countries use one group.
